data.name: Anamay
data.gender_notes: Anamay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anamay is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anam’ meaning ‘without’ and ‘may’ meaning ‘illness’. This name signifies being free from disease and suffering. The name Anamay carries the meaning “Without Illness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anamay usually hope their child will grow to embody without illness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anamay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Without Illness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anamay total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
